lots.key_photo_findings: Two photos (one per neighbouring lot) both show 1118: chalked '1118 16/10/26' with a round lot tag, standing between 1117 and 1119 against corrugated iron. Narrowest of the run, fairly straight and even width, plain close pale grain, a dark knot or resin pocket lower down, a few small dark checks along the left edge, a yellow paint or crayon mark down part of the right edge, bark mostly off. No figure (no bird's-eye) visible. Species not confirmable from colour alone; pale yellow is consistent with lower-grade Huon but also with macrocarpa.
lots.condition: Rough sawn, unseasoned or air-dried look; small knots and edge checks; looks sound in the photo. Size unknown.
